definitions: To deal with a problem yourself because the people who should have dealt with it have failed to do so.
To take action personally to solve a problem, often because official or expected methods have not worked.
examples: When the police didn't respond, she decided to take matters into her own hands.
Frustrated by the delays, the community decided to take matters into their own hands and clean up the park themselves.
He felt he had to take matters into his own hands to protect his family.
lemma: to take matters into one's own hands
synonyms: to take the law into one's own hands
to take the bull by the horns
source: to take matters into your own hands
